styles.name: Vanguard Pressure
styles.tooltip: Occupy the front early and make blockers insufficient.
styles.description: Honest board pressure from cheap and mid-cost bodies, token turns, charge/burst, and site attacks. The deck wins by forcing repeated combat rather than mostly bypassing blockers.

subStyles.name: Board Beatdown
subStyles.tooltip: Efficient bodies and combat tricks create steady, honest pressure.
subStyles.description: Efficient bodies and combat tricks create steady, honest pressure.

subStyles.name: Burn Pressure
subStyles.tooltip: Board damage is backed by direct damage and Death's Door finishers.
subStyles.description: Board damage is backed by direct damage and Death's Door finishers.

subStyles.name: Token Vanguard
subStyles.tooltip: Token production and anthem effects flood the vanguard.
subStyles.description: Token production and anthem effects flood the vanguard.

subStyles.name: Site-Race Pressure
subStyles.tooltip: The deck prioritizes damaging sites and forcing Death's Door quickly.
subStyles.description: The deck prioritizes damaging sites and forcing Death's Door quickly.

styles.name: Evasive Aggro
styles.tooltip: Kill through hard-to-block damage and awkward attack lanes.
styles.description: Airborne, Stealth, Voidwalk, Submerge, Burrowing, or other evasive angles let threats ignore normal blocking patterns and pressure Avatars or Sites quickly.

subStyles.name: Airborne Pressure
subStyles.tooltip: Airborne bodies and air mobility carry the damage plan.
subStyles.description: Airborne bodies and air mobility carry the damage plan.

subStyles.name: Voidwalk Pressure
subStyles.tooltip: Voidwalk threats attack from the void or strange board positions.
subStyles.description: Voidwalk threats attack from the void or strange board positions.

subStyles.name: Stealth/Infiltrate
subStyles.tooltip: Stealth and control-their-minion effects create unblockable tempo swings.
subStyles.description: Stealth and control-their-minion effects create unblockable tempo swings.

subStyles.name: Submerge Pressure
subStyles.tooltip: Submerge bodies hide from normal interaction and surface to attack.
subStyles.description: Submerge bodies hide from normal interaction and surface to attack.

styles.name: Mobility Control
styles.tooltip: Make combat happen in the wrong place for the opponent.
styles.description: Push, pull, swap, teleport, submerge, bury, drown, force attacks, or otherwise reposition units so the opponent cannot use their board efficiently.

subStyles.name: Drown/Displacement
subStyles.tooltip: Water and forced movement repeatedly convert positioning into removal.
subStyles.description: Water and forced movement repeatedly convert positioning into removal.

subStyles.name: Tempo Displacement
subStyles.tooltip: Push, pull, swap, and bounce effects create tempo wins rather than hard locks.
subStyles.description: Push, pull, swap, and bounce effects create tempo wins rather than hard locks.

subStyles.name: Kiting Control
subStyles.tooltip: Ranged/projectile threats and movement keep combat one-sided.
subStyles.description: Ranged/projectile threats and movement keep combat one-sided.

subStyles.name: Tap/Disable Control
subStyles.tooltip: Disable, silence, immobile, and tap effects prevent enemy threats from acting.
subStyles.description: Disable, silence, immobile, and tap effects prevent enemy threats from acting.

styles.name: Fortress Control
styles.tooltip: Turn Sites into a defensive realm, not just mana.
styles.description: Defensive Sites, walls, chokepoints, big blockers, healing, Ward, and repeated board wipes make attacks inefficient until the control deck can win safely.

subStyles.name: Defensive Realm
subStyles.tooltip: The Atlas is used to slow paths and protect important squares.
subStyles.description: The Atlas is used to slow paths and protect important squares.

subStyles.name: Terrain Prison
subStyles.tooltip: Terrain and auras restrict movement, attacks, or access to key regions.
subStyles.description: Terrain and auras restrict movement, attacks, or access to key regions.

subStyles.name: Ward/Heal Fortress
subStyles.tooltip: Healing, Ward, and protection effects stretch the game until threats take over.
subStyles.description: Healing, Ward, and protection effects stretch the game until threats take over.

styles.name: Champion Threat
styles.tooltip: One central unit or Avatar becomes the main weapon.
styles.description: The Avatar or a single central threat is equipped, protected, moved, and repeatedly used to attack or control the board.

subStyles.name: Armed Avatar
subStyles.tooltip: Artifacts, weapons, and bearer buffs make the Avatar a primary attacker.
subStyles.description: Artifacts, weapons, and bearer buffs make the Avatar a primary attacker.

subStyles.name: Mobile Champion
subStyles.tooltip: Movement and reach effects keep the champion in the right fight.
subStyles.description: Movement and reach effects keep the champion in the right fight.

subStyles.name: Protected Champion
subStyles.tooltip: Ward, healing, bodyguards, or prevention keep the main threat alive.
subStyles.description: Ward, healing, bodyguards, or prevention keep the main threat alive.

styles.name: Sticky Recursion
styles.tooltip: Trade, die, return, and grind through removal.
styles.description: The deck converts death and the cemetery into board presence, tokens, Genesis re-use, or repeatable value so clean answers are hard to maintain.

subStyles.name: Necro Value
subStyles.tooltip: Skeletons, dead minions, and reanimation effects supply repeatable board presence.
subStyles.description: Skeletons, dead minions, and reanimation effects supply repeatable board presence.

subStyles.name: Deathspeaker Genesis
subStyles.tooltip: Dead Genesis minions are copied or replayed for value.
subStyles.description: Dead Genesis minions are copied or replayed for value.

subStyles.name: Sacrifice/Deathrite
subStyles.tooltip: Sacrifice, Deathrite, and death triggers turn trades into resources.
subStyles.description: Sacrifice, Deathrite, and death triggers turn trades into resources.

styles.name: Realm Denial
styles.tooltip: Stop the opponent using their Realm properly.
styles.description: Destroy, replace, disable, flood, bury, or punish Sites; interfere with threshold and Atlas plans; or block paths so the opponent's mana and movement collapse.

subStyles.name: Threshold Denial
subStyles.tooltip: The deck attacks threshold, mana, or site text.
subStyles.description: The deck attacks threshold, mana, or site text.

subStyles.name: Site Destruction
subStyles.tooltip: The deck destroys, replaces, or banishes Sites.
subStyles.description: The deck destroys, replaces, or banishes Sites.

subStyles.name: Path Denial
subStyles.tooltip: Sites and terrain block movement or create pathing traps.
subStyles.description: Sites and terrain block movement or create pathing traps.

styles.name: Resource Engine Midrange
styles.tooltip: Out-scale with ramp, Atlas economy, card flow, and high-rate threats.
styles.description: A broad value style for decks whose main edge is resource production, site economy, tutors, draw, ramp, and efficient threats rather than a single pure aggro or control axis.

subStyles.name: Ramp Midrange
subStyles.tooltip: Site acceleration and mana engines reach large threats early.
subStyles.description: Site acceleration and mana engines reach large threats early.

subStyles.name: Toolbox Goodstuff
subStyles.tooltip: Collection access, tutors, and flexible answers carry the deck.
subStyles.description: Collection access, tutors, and flexible answers carry the deck.

subStyles.name: Atlas Value
subStyles.tooltip: The Atlas is an engine for mana, bodies, or repeated utility.
subStyles.description: The Atlas is an engine for mana, bodies, or repeated utility.

styles.name: Spell Engine Control
styles.tooltip: Survive, loop or chain spells, then win by inevitability.
styles.description: High spell density, tutoring, spell copying, recasting, board wipes, and card flow create a long-game control shell that wins once resources are exhausted.

subStyles.name: Archimago Loop
subStyles.tooltip: Repeated casting or copying of key spells is central to the plan.
subStyles.description: Repeated casting or copying of key spells is central to the plan.

subStyles.name: Removal-Heavy Control
subStyles.tooltip: Removal and sweepers dominate until a finisher appears.
subStyles.description: Removal and sweepers dominate until a finisher appears.

subStyles.name: Tutor/Cantrip Control
subStyles.tooltip: Search, draw, cantrips, and selection are the core engine.
subStyles.description: Search, draw, cantrips, and selection are the core engine.

styles.name: Unknown
styles.tooltip: No stable style signature was strong enough.
styles.description: Used only when the deck has too little information, is an unusual pile, or has no clear common strategic cluster.

subStyles.name: Unclear
subStyles.tooltip: No single style signature dominates from the card mix.
subStyles.description: No single style signature dominates from the card mix.
